title: Migrate knowledge parser source root
summary: Move markdown/frontmatter/link parsing and diagram/file-structure parsing ownership into src/knowledge/** while preserving graph and audit behavior.

goal.outcome: Knowledge parsing and diagram/file-structure parsing have source-root ownership under src/knowledge/**.
acceptance: Create src/knowledge/** owner modules for ParsedDoc, markdown/frontmatter/link parsing, diagram parsing, diagram-ref validation, and file-structure drift parsing helpers.
Update graph, rebuild, lint, audit, tests, and scripts to import parser behavior from src/knowledge/**.
Remove old src/application/knowledge/** owner paths or retain only explicit temporary shims with TASK-specific tests.
Preserve alignment, stale-reference, file-structure, generated-parity, graph rebuild, and package smoke behavior.
Add TASK-specific guard proving legacy knowledge parser imports are gone or explicitly shimmed.
non_goals: Do not migrate project/bootstrap, roadmap, session, state/graph ownership beyond parser consumer import updates, GC, change/diff-table, adapters/UI, or skills.
Do not change diagram YAML schema, markdown parsing semantics, audit profile names, or graph JSON schema.
